title: C: Pathfinding (Dijkstra)
description: Implement Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm on a weighted graph.

steps.title: Dijkstra Implementation
steps.description: Define a graph with 5 nodes and weighted edges. Implement Dijkstra's algorithm: `void dijkstra(int graph[5][5], int start)` that prints the shortest distances from start to all nodes. Test with a 5-node graph.
hints: Graph is adjacency matrix with 0 for no edge.
Use int array for distances, initialized to large values.
Use a visited array to track processed nodes.
Find the unvisited node with smallest distance.

verification.failureMessage: Print shortest distances from node 0 to all nodes
